definitions.source_refined: Left CARLA toe joint Z minus its 0.035 m ground proxy, in cm.
definitions.glance: Geodesic rotation angle between CARLA head orientations of edited and refined motions, in degrees.
definitions.pause: Euclidean horizontal root speed from numpy.gradient with actual timestamps, m/s.
definitions.wider: Horizontal root displacement magnitude from source, cm; this authored edit is purely lateral.

head_note: The measured edit mainly changes head tilt. Panel is labeled Head pose. Walk and Edited use the same 3.0 s instant; Later is the edited motion at 5.0 s.

path_view.description: Full source and authored root trajectories projected at ground height 0.02 m through the actual top-down CARLA camera. Image is wider motion at 2.33 s. No image reflection or nonuniform scaling.
